messages:
maria: kicking off post-deploy smoke for release v3.8.2 — can folks watch eu-west1 synths for ~10m?
deploy-bot: deploy v3.8.2 -> eu-west1 started by @maria at 2025-11-02T14:45:23Z :rocket:
henry: on it, starting query loop against /health and /embed-smoke. will report back if anything >200ms or 5xx.
sophie: i'll keep an eye on the synthetic-kv probe dashboard, flagging if TTL misses >3%
liam: FYI I'll tail the edge-proxy logs for connection resets, last time that caused cascade.
deploy-bot: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% schedule set, hold window 15m after each step
maria: canary step completed to 10% — no errors yet, latency looks fine (p95 ~110ms)
henry: seeing a small spike on one host: eu-west1-gpu-03 p95 420ms, 502 errors in probe logs
sophie: weird, synthetic-kv probe shows prefix-miss rate jumped to 4.1% around 14:47:10
liam: grep from proxy: ```
2025-11-02T14:47:08Z ERROR upstream reset id=0x14 conn=172.16.3.18:443
2025-11-02T14:47:09Z WARN kv-cache miss key="session-prefix-9b2"
```
oncall-bot: incident-policy: low-latency-degradation triggered for eu-west1, paging oncall
maria: ok let's hold the rollout at 50% and run a focused probe sweep across the 3 instances with high miss rates
henry: isolating eu-west1-gpu-03 — repro: running the embed smoke locally against that instance returns 502 consistently
sophie: digging into kv-cache metrics, evictions shot up at 14:46:50. maybe GC/oom killer on that host? memory looks high in host metrics (resident ~11.8GiB)
liam: pulling container logs, saw repeated GC pause logs and one OOMKilled event at 14:46:58.
maria: good catch. roll this host out of the rotation and restart the agent. @deploy-bot can you pin traffic away from eu-west1-gpu-03?
deploy-bot: pinned traffic: removed eu-west1-gpu-03 from canary pool. routing policy now excludes 172.16.3.18
henry: restarted agent on eu-west1-gpu-03, post-restart probes show 200/OK and p95 back down to ~120ms
sophie: kv miss rate back to 0.6% after restart, evictions normalized
liam: proxy logs show no more resets after agent restart
maria: can we continue to 100%? any residual risk?
oncall-bot: note: paging auto-silenced, alert still open until p95 <200ms for 10m
henry: I'm comfortable moving forward, but recommend keeping the 15m hold after 100% to watch synths
sophie: agree. I'll leave extended sampling on the synthetic-kv test for 20m
maria: continuing rollout to 100% now. thanks team.
deploy-bot: canary progressed to 100% at 2025-11-02T14:53:40Z — automated postdeploy smoke will run for 20m
liam: quick follow-up: I'll create a short postmortem note in the release doc about host memory tuning and GC thresholds
maria: please add suggested change: bump agent JVM heap mem limit to 12g -> 14g and increase kv-cache target capacity by 8%
liam: copied into release notes draft. tagging @infra for follow-up on host sizing
henry: final check: no further 5xx, p95 stable ~115ms across regions
sophie: synth probes green for the 20m window, closing the smoke run
maria: excellent. closing thread — release v3.8.2 fully rolled out. great response time everyone :tada:
deploy-bot: release v3.8.2 -> eu-west1 marked success at 2025-11-02T14:56:00Z
